title: Controller bindings use original-style button glyphs
summary: Pause → Controls → Controller bindings now draws each binding with PS2-style glyphs redrawn after the original Controller Settings page (PAGE17). Chord buttons are joined by the original blue "+". An original-style translucent panel groups ATV, Stunt and Camera controls from the live controller profile.
details: Glyph colours sampled from the original button textures; vectors only, no original texture shipped.
Only actions the port has are listed; the original's fixed presets and Look Back, Thrill, Pan, Dolly and Zoom cameras are omitted, as are unbound actions.
Text labels now read Cross / R2, Left stick left; pads reporting a non-standard mapping keep raw Button/Axis names.
Verified: unit tests, test_settings.mjs and test_bindings.mjs browser tests, inspected 1280×800 and 390×844 captures (PR #158).
limitation: Face buttons use PlayStation shapes, as in the original; Xbox/Nintendo letter glyphs are not shown. No physical controller was tested. Host captures, not a verified public release.
